user.title: WAREMA WMS WebControl
user.description: Enter the address of your local WebControl box. The box must be reachable directly (e.g. http://webcontrol.local or its IP address).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the WebControl box at this address.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This WebControl box is already configured.

init.title: WAREMA WMS WebControl options
init.description: Scenes are discovered from the box automatically. Presets are only needed for extra, manually captured commands: one line per preset as "Name | payload_hex" (a name for a discovered scene payload replaces its display name). Device class and position inversion: one line per channel, e.g. "channel name = awning" or "channel name = false" (optional; otherwise the type is read from the box). Exclude channels applies to covers only, not to scenes.

data.exclude_channels: Exclude channels (one channel name per line)
data.clock_sync: Set the box clock automatically (at startup and daily, if off by more than 60 s)

error.invalid_preset: Each preset line must be "Name | payload_hex" with an even-length hex payload.

box_unreachable.title: WebControl box unreachable
box_unreachable.description: The WebControl box at {url} has not answered since {since} ({error}). Shades cannot be controlled from Home Assistant and wind/rain automations will not work. Check the box and its power supply, restart it if needed. This notice disappears once the box answers again.
